questions.text:
हड़प्पा की अर्थव्यवस्था के बारे में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं ?
I. शहरी केंद्रों में संगठित शिल्प उत्पादन के अवशेष मिले हैं।
II. कृषि के लिए लोहे के औज़ारों का उपयोग आम था।
III. मुहरों के साक्ष्य लंबी दूरी के व्यापारिक संपर्कों का संकेत देते हैं।
IV. मानकीकृत बाट विनियमित व्यापारिक संपर्कों की ओर संकेत करते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Which of the following statements about the Harappan economy are correct?
I. Urban centres provide remains of organized craft production.
II. Use of iron tools for agriculture was common.
III. Evidence of seals indicates long distance trade.
IV. Standardised weights point towards regulated trade contacts.
questions.solution: Statements I, III, and IV are correct. Harappan civilization did not have evidence of common iron tool usage for agriculture (Statement II is incorrect), as it was a Bronze Age civilization. Organized craft production, long-distance trade via seals, and standardized weights for regulation are archaeologically established facts.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : अशोक के अधिकांश अभिलेख प्राकृत भाषा में थे।
कारण (R) : प्राकृत का प्रयोग आम लोगों तक संदेश पहुँचाने के उनके प्रयास को दर्शाता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Most Asokan inscriptions were in the Prakrit language.
Reason (R): The use of Prakrit shows his attempt to spread the message amongst the common people.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both the assertion and reason are true, and the reason correctly explains why Asoka used Prakrit—to make his inscriptions accessible to common people throughout his empire.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित शासकों को कालक्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित कीजिए :

II. महापद्म नंद

IV. चन्द्रगुप्त मौर्य
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following rulers in chronological order:
I. Kanishka
II. Mahapadma Nanda
III. Samudragupta
IV. Chandragupta Maurya
questions.solution: The correct chronological order is Mahapadma Nanda (Nanda Dynasty), followed by Chandragupta Maurya (Maurya Dynasty), then Kanishka (Kushan Dynasty), and finally Samudragupta (Gupta Dynasty).

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित जानकारी की सहायता से महाभारत के पात्र की पहचान कीजिए :

Identify the character from the Mahabharata with the help of the following information:
• He was the elder brother of Pandu.
• He was the king of Hastinapur.
• He was the husband of Gandhari.
questions.solution: Dhritarashtra was the elder brother of Pandu, the king of Hastinapur, and the husband of Gandhari.

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए बोधिसत्त के चित्र को देखिए और निम्नलिखित विकल्पों में से इस प्राचीन कला शैली की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Look at the image of Bodhisatta given below and identify the ancient school of art from the following options:
questions.solution: The image depicts a Bodhisattva figure, and the artistic style—evident in the drapery and facial features—is characteristic of the Gandhara school of art.

questions.text:
स्तंभ A का स्तंभ B से मिलान कीजिए :
स्तंभ A: धोलावीरा, मोहनजोदड़ो, कालीबंगन, नागेश्वर
स्तंभ B: i. विशाल स्नानागार, ii. जुते हुए खेत, iii. शिल्प केंद्र, iv. जलाशय
questions.text_english:
Match Column A with Column B:
Column A: Dholavira, Mohenjodaro, Kalibangan, Nageshwar
Column B: i. Great Bath, ii. Ploughed Fields, iii. Craft Centre, iv. Water Reservoir
questions.solution: Dholavira is known for its water reservoir (a-iv), Mohenjodaro features the Great Bath (b-i), Kalibangan is identified by evidence of ploughed fields (c-ii), and Nageshwar was a significant craft centre (d-iii).

questions.text: उत्तराधिकार की उस प्रणाली की पहचान कीजिए जिस पर छठी शताब्दी ई.पू. से राजवंशों द्वारा महत्त्व दिया गया और जिसे महाभारत में सुदृढ़ किया गया।
questions.text_english: Identify the system of succession that was emphasised by ruling dynasties from the sixth century BCE onwards and reinforced in the Mahabharata.
questions.solution: Patriliny, or patrilineal succession, was the system where sons inherited the father's throne and resources, which was reinforced in the Mahabharata and followed by ruling dynasties of the era.

questions.text:

questions.text_english:
Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
(A) Antonio Monserrate : Italy
(B) Duarte Barbosa : France
(C) Jean-Baptiste Tavernier : Portugal
(D) Peter Mundy : England
questions.solution: Peter Mundy was an English traveller. Antonio Monserrate was a Spanish Jesuit, Duarte Barbosa was Portuguese, and Jean-Baptiste Tavernier was French.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन अमीर खुसरो का सटीक वर्णन करते हैं ?
I. वह एक महान कवि और संगीतज्ञ थे।

III. वे शेख मोइनुद्दीन चिश्ती के शिष्य थे।
IV. उन्होंने कव्वाली परंपरा की नींव रखी।
questions.text_english:
Which of the following statements accurately describes Amir Khusrau?
I. He was a great poet and musician.
II. He introduced the qaul in Chishti Sama.
III. He was a disciple of Shaikh Muinuddin Sijzi.
IV. He laid the foundation of qawwali tradition.

options.A: II, III और IV सही हैं।
options.B: I, II और IV सही हैं।
options.C: I, III और IV सही हैं।
options.D: I, II और III सही हैं।

options_english.A: II, III and IV are correct.
options_english.B: I, II and IV are correct.
options_english.C: I, III and IV are correct.
options_english.D: I, II and III are correct.

questions.solution: Amir Khusrau was a great poet-musician, introduced 'qaul' (utterance), and founded the qawwali tradition. He was a disciple of Shaikh Nizamuddin Auliya, not Shaikh Muinuddin Sijzi (Statement III is incorrect).

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से किस युद्ध के कारण 1565 में विजयनगर साम्राज्य का पतन हुआ ?

questions.solution: The Battle of Talikota in 1565 was a major military defeat that significantly contributed to the decline and fall of the Vijayanagara Empire.

questions.text: पंजाब में शाह नहर की मरम्मत _______ के शासनकाल के दौरान की गई थी।
questions.text_english: The Shah Nahar Canal in Punjab was repaired during the reign of _______.
questions.solution: The Shah Nahar Canal was repaired during the reign of Shahjahan, as noted in Mughal historical accounts regarding irrigation improvements.

questions.text: अकबर के शासनकाल के दौरान निम्नलिखित में से किस प्रकार की भूमि पर बिना खाली छोड़े, हर साल खेती की जाती थी ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following types of land was cultivated every year without leaving it fallow during the reign of Akbar?
questions.solution: Polaj was the best type of land in the Mughal system, which was cultivated annually without ever being left fallow.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : 1857 के विद्रोह में सिपाहियों ने बहादुर शाह ज़फ़र को अपना नेता घोषित किया।
कारण (R) : बहादुर शाह ज़फ़र के समर्थन से 1857 के विद्रोह को वैधता मिली।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): The Sepoys proclaimed Bahadur Shah Zafar as their leader in the Revolt of 1857.
Reason (R): Bahadur Shah Zafar's acceptance gave legitimacy to the Revolt of 1857.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The Sepoys proclaimed Bahadur Shah Zafar as the leader because his position as the Mughal Emperor provided a symbolic legitimacy that the rebels needed to unite against British rule.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित जानकारी की सहायता से उन्नीसवीं शताब्दी के भारतीय समाज सुधारक की पहचान कीजिए :

questions.text_english:
Identify the Indian social reformer of the nineteenth century with the help of the following information:
• Opposed child marriage
• Advocated for social justice
• Campaigned for reform of Hinduism
• Known for Vedantic theory
questions.solution: Swami Vivekananda is the social reformer described; he campaigned for Hindu reform, stood for social justice, opposed regressive social practices, and was a staunch exponent of Vedantic philosophy.

questions.text: दक्कन दंगा आयोग ने एक रिपोर्ट तैयार की, जो 1878 में _______ पार्लियामेंट में पेश की गई।
questions.text_english: The Deccan Riots Commission produced a report that was presented to the _______ Parliament in 1878.
questions.solution: The Deccan Riots Commission report was presented to the British Parliament in 1878, as India was under British colonial rule.

questions.text:
(क) कल्पना कीजिए कि आप राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय में प्रदर्शित हड़प्पा मुहरों का अध्ययन कर रहे एक शोधार्थी हैं। व्यापार और प्रशासन में हड़प्पा मुहरों की भूमिका के किन्हीं तीन पहलुओं को स्पष्ट कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) कल्पना कीजिए कि आप राष्ट्रीय संग्रहालय में हैं और मोहनजोदड़ो में मिली 'पुरोहित-राजा' की मूर्ति की प्रतिकृति देख रहे हैं। इस कलाकृति से आप हड़प्पा के बारे में कौन-से तीन निष्कर्ष निकालेंगे ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Imagine you are a research scholar studying Harappan seals displayed in the National Museum. Explain any three aspects about the role of Harappan seals in trade and administration.
OR
(b) Imagine you are visiting the National Museum and see the replica of the 'Priest-King' stone statue from Mohenjodaro. Which three conclusions would you make about Harappa from this artefact? Explain.
questions.solution: Option (a): Firstly, seals were used to facilitate long-distance trade by acting as a mark of ownership on goods in transit. Secondly, they ensured that the contents of packages had not been tampered with upon reaching the destination. Thirdly, they served administrative functions by carrying the identity of the sender or the authority overseeing the trade. Option (b): Firstly, the statue demonstrates the advanced craftsmanship of the Harappan civilization. Secondly, the dignified posture suggests the existence of a high-status elite or priestly class in Harappan society. Thirdly, the attention to detail in clothing and ornamentation points toward a stratified society with sophisticated aesthetic preferences.

questions.text: मौर्य साम्राज्य के इतिहास के पुनर्निर्माण के लिए किन्हीं तीन स्रोतों का वर्णन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Describe any three sources to reconstruct the history of the Mauryan Empire.

key_points: Archaeological finds like stone sculptures and inscriptions
Literary sources like the Arthashastra and Indica
Asoka's inscriptions providing royal policies

questions.solution: Three primary sources for reconstructing the Mauryan Empire are firstly, archaeological finds such as stone sculptures and monuments which offer physical evidence of architectural and artistic styles. Secondly, literary sources like Chanakya's Arthashastra provide insights into administration and Kautilya's political theories, alongside Megasthenes' Indica. Thirdly, the rock and pillar inscriptions of Asoka serve as the most crucial source, detailing royal policies, social views, and the extent of the empire.

questions.text: बर्नियर के विवरण ने भारतीय महिलाओं की सकारात्मक भूमिका को कैसे उजागर किया ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: How did Bernier's account highlight the positive role of Indian women? Explain.

key_points: Women's role in labor and production
Their engagement in domestic and socio-economic life
Strength observed in widow's choice or societal duties

questions.solution: Bernier highlighted that women were an integral part of the productive workforce in India, often engaging in arduous labor both inside and outside the domestic sphere. He observed their participation in weaving and various craft activities, acknowledging that Indian women played a significant role in maintaining the family economy through their continuous work, thereby showcasing a level of resilience and contribution that he found noteworthy.

questions.text:
(क) कबीर निर्गुण भक्ति के संत-कवियों में से एक अत्यंत उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण हैं। इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) “छठी शताब्दी के अलवारों ने एक समृद्ध सांस्कृतिक विरासत की रचना की। इस कथन की व्याख्या कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Kabir is one of the most outstanding examples of poet-saints of Nirguna Bhakti Explain the statement.
OR
(b) Alvars of the sixth century created a rich cultural legacy. Explain the statement.
questions.solution: Option (a): Kabir rejected idol worship, pilgrimages, and the authority of orthodox religious texts, promoting 'Nirguna' or formless worship of the Divine. His poetry challenged social hierarchies based on caste and religion, advocating for a direct, internalized experience of God through love and humility. Option (b): The Alvars were Tamil poet-saints who were devoted to Lord Vishnu. They traveled from place to place, composing hymns that expressed intense, emotional longing for God. Their compositions, later compiled in the Nalayira Divyaprabandham, integrated Tamil devotional tradition with the wider Vedic and Puranic religious framework, establishing a profoundly influential cultural and spiritual legacy.

questions.text: 1813 की पाँचवीं रिपोर्ट के विभिन्न पहलुओं की आलोचनात्मक परख कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Critically examine the varied aspects of the Fifth Report of 1813.

key_points: Report on East India Company administration
Critique of the zamindari system and its abuses
Impact on rural life and local power structures

questions.solution: The Fifth Report of 1813 was presented to the British Parliament to review the East India Company's administrative and judicial management in India. It contained an exhaustive collection of documents, petitions, and evidence that criticized the abuses of the zamindari system, highlighting the distress faced by the ryots. However, critics argue the report was biased, intended to discredit the Company's monopoly and justify greater Parliamentary control over India's rural administration.

questions.text: भारतीय कला और साहित्य ने 1857 के विद्रोह को प्रथम स्वतंत्रता संग्राम के रूप में किस प्रकार चित्रित किया ? स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: How did Indian art and literature depict the Revolt of 1857 as the First War of Independence? Explain.

key_points: Portrayal of heroes like Rani Lakshmibai
Literature focusing on nationalistic sentiment
Art celebrating anti-colonial defiance

questions.solution: Art and literature in India transformed the Revolt of 1857 into a symbol of heroic defiance against colonial power. Poems and plays depicted figures like Rani Lakshmibai as icons of national resistance. By focusing on the struggle for autonomy rather than just a mutiny, these creative works fostered a shared sense of patriotism, effectively reinterpreting the event as a foundational 'First War of Independence' in the collective nationalist memory.

questions.text_english:
(a) Mahabharata is considered as a dynamic text. Explain the statement with examples.
OR
(b) Mahabharata reinforced the ideas of familial values. Explain the statement with examples.
questions.solution: Option (a): The Mahabharata is considered a 'dynamic text' because it has evolved continuously over centuries. The original narrative was added to, modified, and reinterpreted by various authors, scribes, and regional communities, leading to diverse versions across India and Southeast Asia. The inclusion of new didactic sections like the Bhagavad Gita and the constant adaptation of the story to fit different social contexts illustrate its living, flexible nature. Option (b): The Mahabharata emphasizes the importance of 'Patriliny' and the duty of sons toward their fathers. It reinforces social order through the conflict between the Kauravas and the Pandavas, showcasing the virtues of familial bonds, hierarchy, and the consequences of transgressing family duty. Stories within the text, such as those of the Kuru dynasty, serve as ethical benchmarks for society regarding family roles, inheritance, and governance.

questions.text_english:
(a) Examine the structural and ceremonial features of the Mahanavami Dibba of the Vijayanagara Empire.
OR
(b) Examine the distinctive features of the Vijayanagara fortifications that reflected the strength of the empire.
questions.solution: Option (a): The Mahanavami Dibba is a high platform with a massive base and elaborate carvings. It served as a central stage for the Mahanavami festival, a nine-day Hindu ritual. During this event, the king displayed his power, wealth, and military strength before his vassals and guests. Ceremonies included the worship of the state deity and the review of the army, reinforcing the king's legitimacy. Option (b): The fortifications of Vijayanagara were highly sophisticated, featuring multiple concentric walls that enclosed agricultural fields and forests, ensuring the city could withstand long sieges. The masonry was unique, using stone interlocking blocks without mortar. These walls protected not just the royal center, but the urban population, and gateways were strategically guarded, symbolizing the military might and strategic foresight of the Vijayanagara rulers.

questions.text_english:
(a) The Non-Cooperation Movement became an unprecedented popular movement in the history of colonial India.Justify the statement with suitable arguments.
OR
(b) The Salt Satyagraha was an all-India campaign in opposition to colonial rule.Justify the statement with suitable arguments.
questions.solution: Option (a): The Non-Cooperation Movement (1920-22) was unprecedented because it saw mass participation across different social classes, including students, lawyers, and rural peasants. It encouraged the boycott of British schools, courts, and foreign goods, and promoted the use of Khadi, symbolizing a move toward self-reliance. Its nationwide scope marked a shift from elite-led politics to a mass movement, significantly challenging the administrative and moral legitimacy of British colonial rule in India. Option (b): The Salt Satyagraha (1930) was an all-India campaign because it brought people from various regions and backgrounds together, unified by a common cause against the unjust British salt tax. Gandhi's Dandi March resonated across the nation, triggering widespread civil disobedience. It involved women, peasants, and city-dwellers, and its reach extended far beyond the coast, demonstrating that the struggle against colonial rule was truly a national, pan-Indian endeavour.

Verses from the Upanishads
Here are two verses from the Chhandogya Upanishad, a text composed in Sanskrit c. sixth century BCE:

The nature of the self
This self of mine within the heart, is smaller than paddy or barley or mustard or millet or the kernel of a seed of millet. This self of mine within the heart is greater than the earth, greater than the intermediate space, greater than heaven, greater than these worlds.

questions.text:
भारत में चाँदी कैसे आई
जोवान्नी कारेरी के लेख (बर्नियर के लेख पर आधारित) के निम्नलिखित अंश से हमें पता चलता है कि मुगल साम्राज्य में कितनी भारी मात्रा में बाहर से धन आ रहा था :
(मुगल) साम्राज्य की धन-संपत्ति का अंदाज़ा लगाने के लिए पाठक इस बात पर गौर करें कि दुनिया भर में बिचरने वाला सारा सोना-चाँदी आखिरकार यहीं पहुँच जाता है। ये सब जानते हैं कि इसका बहुत बड़ा हिस्सा अमेरिका से आता है, और यूरोप के कई राज्यों से होते हुए, (इसका) थोड़ा-सा हिस्सा कई तरह की वस्तुओं के लिए तुर्की में जाता है; और थोड़ा-सा हिस्सा रेशम के लिए स्मिरना होते हुए फ़ारस पहुँचता है। अब चूँकि तुर्की लोग कॉफ़ी से अलग नहीं रह सकते, जो कि ओमान और अरबिया से आती है... (और) न ही फ़ारस, अरबिया, और तुर्की (के लोग) भारत की वस्तुओं के बिना रह सकते हैं। (वे) मुद्रा की विशाल मात्रा लाल सागर पर बेबल मंडेल के पास स्थित मोचा भेजते हैं; (इसी तरह वे ये मुद्राएँ) फ़ारस की खाड़ी पर स्थित बसरा भेजते हैं; ... बाद में ये (सारी संपत्ति) जहाज़ों से इन्दोस्तान (हिंदुस्तान) भेज दी जाती है। भारतीय जहाज़ों के अलावा जो डच, अंग्रेज़ी और पुर्तगाली जहाज़ हर साल इन्दोस्तान की वस्तुएँ लेकर पेगू, तानस्सेरी (म्याँमार के हिस्से), स्याम (थाइलैंड), सीलोन (श्रीलंका) ... मालदीव के टापू, मोज़ाम्बिक और अन्य जगहें ले जाते हैं, (इन्हीं जहाज़ों को) निश्चित तौर पर बहुत सारा सोना-चाँदी इन देशों से लेकर वहाँ (हिंदुस्तान) पहुँचाना पड़ता है। वो सब कुछ, जो डच लोग जापान की खानों से हासिल करते हैं, देर-सवेर इन्दोस्तान (को) चला जाता है; और यहाँ से यूरोप को जाने वाली सारी वस्तुएँ, चाहे वो फ्रांस जाएँ या इंग्लैंड या पुर्तगाल, सभी नकद में खरीदी जाती हैं, जो (नकद) वहीं (हिन्दुस्तान में) रह जाता है।
questions.text_english:
How Silver Came to India
This excerpt from Giovanni Careri's account (based on Bernier's account) gives an idea of the enormous amount of wealth that found its way into the Mughal Empire:

That the Reader may form some idea of the Wealth of this (Mughal) Empire, he is to observe that all the Gold and Silver, which circulates throughout the World at last Centres here. It is well known that as much of it comes out of America, after running through several Kingdoms of Europe, goes partly into Turky (Turkey), for several sorts of Commodities; and part into Persia, by the way of Smirna for Silk. Now the Turks not being able to abstain from Coffee, which comes from Hyeman (Oman), and Arabia nor Persia, Arabia, and the Turks themselves to go without the commodities of India, send vast quantities of Mony (money) to Moka (Mocha) on the Red Sea, near Babel Mandel; to Bassora (Basra) at the bottom of the Persian Gulgh (Gulf); which is afterwards sent over in Ships to Indostan (Hindustan). Besides the Indian, Dutch, English, and Portuguese Ships, that every Year carry the Commodities of Indostan to Pegu, Tanasserri (parts of Myanmar), Siam (Thailand), Ceylon (Sri Lanka) ... the Maldive Islands, Mozambique and other Places, must of necessity convey much Gold and Silver thither, from those Countries. All that the Dutch fetch from the Mines in Japan, sooner or later, goes to Indostan; and the goods carry'd hence into Europe, whether to France, England, or Portugal, are all purchas'd for ready Mony, which remains there.

questions.text:
संविधान का निर्माण
भारतीय संविधान 26 जनवरी, 1950 को अस्तित्व में आया और यह दुनिया का सबसे लंबा संविधान है। यदि हम अपने देश के आकार और विविधता पर ध्यान दें तो इसकी लंबाई व पेचीदगी को आसानी से समझ सकते हैं। स्वतंत्रता के समय भारत न केवल एक विशाल और विविधतापूर्ण बल्कि गहरे तौर पर बिखरा हुआ देश भी था। ऐसे में देश की एकजुटता और प्रगति के लिए एक विस्तृत, गहन विचार-विमर्श पर आधारित और सावधानीपूर्वक सूत्रबद्ध किया गया संविधान लाज़िमी था। हमारे संविधान ने अतीत और वर्तमान के घावों पर मरहम लगाने और विभिन्न वर्गों, जातियों व समुदायों में बँटे भारतीयों को एक साझा राजनीतिक प्रयोग में शामिल करने में मदद दी है। दूसरी ओर, इस संविधान ने लंबे समय से चली आ रही ऊँच-नीच और अधीनता की संस्कृति में लोकतांत्रिक संस्थानों को विकसित करने का भी प्रयास किया है। भारत के संविधान को दिसंबर 1946 से नवंबर 1949 के बीच सूत्रबद्ध किया गया। इस दौरान संविधान सभा में इसके मसविदे के एक-एक भाग पर लंबी चर्चाएँ चलीं।
questions.text_english:
Framing the Constitution
The Indian Constitution, which came into effect on 26 January, 1950, has the dubious distinction of being the longest in the world. But its length and complexity are perhaps understandable when one considers the country's size and diversity. At Independence, India was not merely large and diverse, but also deeply divided. A Constitution designed to keep the country together, and to take it forward, had necessarily to be an elaborate, carefully-worked-out, and painstakingly drafted document. For one thing, it sought to heal wounds of the past and the present, to make Indians of different classes, castes and communities come together in a shared political experiment. For another, it sought to nurture democratic institutions in what had long been a culture of hierarchy and deference. The Constitution of India was framed between December 1946 and November 1949. During this time, its drafts were discussed clause-by-clause in the Constituent Assembly of India.

key_points: Integrating diverse classes and communities
Replacing hierarchy with democratic institutions

sub_questions.solution: The Constitution sought to nurture democracy by creating a shared political experiment for diverse classes and castes, and by replacing a long-standing culture of social hierarchy and deference with democratic institutions.
